gloss: to end; to finish; to conclude

definitions.gloss: to end; to finish; to conclude; to be completed
definitions.explanation: To come to an end or bring something to completion. Used for events, programs, processes, and periods of time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧した。
⟦キャンペーン→キャンペーン：10809_kyanpeen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今月末|こんげつまつ}→今月末：28384_kongetsumatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧します。
examples.english: The campaign will end at the end of this month.

examples.japanese: ⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終了|しゅうりょう}する⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}らないで→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not turn off the computer until the system update has finished.

notes:
A formal, commonly used word for endings and completions. Frequently seen in announcements, signs, and system messages. More formal and definitive than {終|お}わる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧: registration closed
- ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧: business hours ended; closed for the day
- ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧: sales ended; no longer available
- ⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧: streaming ended; service discontinued
- ⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: ending time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {終|お}わる: to end — the most common everyday word; less formal
- ⟦{完了|かんりょう}する→完了する：20676_kanryousuru⟧: to complete — emphasizes that a task or process has been fully finished
- ⟦{閉会|へいかい}→閉会：23962_heikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to close (a meeting/ceremony) — used specifically for formal gatherings

USAGE:
Primarily intransitive (the event ends), but can be used transitively in some contexts (⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{終了|しゅうりょう}する). Very common on signs and in digital interfaces, such as buttons labeled ⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧.
